svg.text: Conflating the 2-adic and 3-adic towers — down-sampled, with a spinner sweep
hero: all of 2^2…2^46 (cyan Hilbert) ⊕ 3^2…3^20 (magenta Peano), each rung down-sampled to a drawable layer and spun at its own rate
23 two-adic rungs ⊕ 10 three-adic rungs conflated · large rungs down-sampled (top-L layer) · screen-blended · cohere ⇄ decohere
spinner parameter sweep — columns: rotation period (fast → slow) · rows: frequency drift (coherent → decoherent)
